title: Beef and Pilaf Stroganoff
description: A classic Russian dish made with sautéed beef and served over a bed of creamy pilaf.
instructions: Cook the pilaf according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onions and cook until they are translucent, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir in the Dijon mustard.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the beef is coated in the sauce.
Stir in the cooked pilaf and cook for 1-2 minutes, until everything is well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream.
